svg.text: End-to-end architecture · realtime data flow · cache strategy · data-safety guarantees
SWR cache · SSE live badges · lazy routes
Server-rendered SPA routes, no auth needed.
Served from the same Vercel build.
same-origin API, no CORS in dev
topic fan-out · 25s heartbeat · event log for replay
writes invalidate cache BEFORE notifying clients
publishThrottled: 1.5s per topic/type, trailing always sent
namespace versions → O(1) invalidation · single-flight loads
MongoDB is the source of truth
A · Count tap → live dashboard (no polling)
Each write is one findOneAndUpdate ($max merge) — concurrent devices cannot overwrite each other.
Fresh data paints instantly from memory; the network call runs in the background. Typical cached response: < 5 ms.
Three failed reconnects switch to 15s version polling — the UI stays live either way.
Trim only after a durable copy. Restore upserts by _id and takes a pre-restore snapshot.
One timezone for every counter, one atomic write per tap, indexes for every hot query.
Single source of truth: MongoDB. Everything else is derived and rebuildable.
